---
title: Reactivity with ojs 
categories: [observable, test]
---


```{ojs}
mutable x = 10;

function setX(v) {
    mutable x += v;
}
```

1 - The value of `x` is `{ojs} {x}`.

2 - The value of `x` is ${x}.

```{ojs}
md`3 - The values of \`x\` is ${x}.`;
```

```{ojs}
viewof button = Inputs.button("X", {reduce:() => {setX(1)}})
```
